PluginData.Tooltip: Adds single-bounce screen space diffuse global illumination.
PluginData.Description:
Adds single-bounce screen space diffuse global illumination.
This is a gpu-heavy plugin, and you will experience a significant drop in fps when it is enabled. Various parameters can be changed in Anomaly Shaders → SSGI → Settings (Rich HUD) or the Pulsar config dialog, including quality presets and GI intensity.
Sampling is based on the SSILVB algorithm with a modified SVGF denoiser. Requires Anomaly Shader Framework.
